heading: Our coverage continues
body: This live page is now closed, but our round-the-clock coverage of the US-Israel war on Iran, the fighting in Yemen, as well as Israel’s attacks on Gaza, the occupied West Bank and Lebanon continues.

heading: Here’s what happened today
body: This live page will close soon. Before we go, here’s a look at some of the top recent developments:

heading: WATCH: Has Gaza broken the Israel consensus in the US?
body: For decades, US support for Israel was one of Washington’s few unbreakable bipartisan positions. The genocide in Gaza has changed that.

heading: 6 killed as IRGC raid targets ‘terrorists’ planning attack near Tehran

heading: Israeli military conducts large explosion in second southern Lebanon town

heading: Saudi Arabia approves $59m of budget funding for Yemen’s government

heading: Supertanker hit in Strait of Hormuz, Iranian media reports

heading: Netanyahu issues new threats against Iran’s supreme leader
body: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu has threatened Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei during a graduation ceremony for Israeli forces, according to a post shared on his X account.

heading: Iran, China discuss strengthening Global South cooperation, says Iranian Deputy FM
body: Iran and China have emphasised the need to “develop Global South cooperation”, according to Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi.

heading: WATCH: Actor Jason Alexander recalls Palestinian protection in Ramallah
body: Seinfeld actor Jason Alexander recalls a visit to Ramallah that challenged his fears about visiting Palestinian cities as a Jewish American.

heading: Qatar, France urge continued international presence in Lebanon
body: In their joint statement, Qatar and France have reaffirmed their commitment to supporting Lebanon’s sovereignty.

heading: Qatar sign four-nation defence pact amid ‘unprecedented security risks’
body: The new defence agreement between Qatar, Turkiye, Pakistan and Indonesia focuses on developing cooperation between the four countries’ defence industrial bases, according to Rashid al-Mohanadi, a security and defence analyst.

heading: Israeli forces fire ‘indiscriminately’ during incursion in southwestern Syria
body: Israeli forces have deployed snipers atop civilian homes and fired indiscriminately across residential neighbourhoods in Jamla village, located in the southwestern Syrian governorate of Deraa, according to Syrian state television.

heading: Photos: Israeli forces, settlers block Palestinians from olive harvest in occupied West Bank

heading: British jets for Saudi Arabia to defend against Houthis build on long military bond
body: The UK has announced it will deploy Typhoon fighters to help defend Saudi Arabia from missile and drone attacks by Yemen’s Houthis.

heading: Three air strikes hit Yemen’s al-Sarari region in Taiz: Houthi-affiliated media
body: Houthi-affiliated media reports that three air strikes have hit the al-Sarari area in Taiz Governorate, southwestern Yemen.

heading: Netanyahu denies UK media report that Trump halted planned Israeli strike on Iran
body: Israel’s PM has denied a Financial Times report that Trump halted Israeli plans to attack Iran earlier this month.
